headline: Verstappen beats Leclerc to Singapore Grand Prix pole by 0.054s
body: Verstappen took pole for the Singapore Grand Prix with a 1:31.373, just 0.054s ahead of Leclerc. Hamilton qualified third and Antonelli fourth, with Norris fifth and Russell sixth before his grid penalty.

headline: No penalty for Norris and Piastri after Singapore sprint clash
body: Norris and Piastri received no penalty for their final-lap collision at Turn 5. Both contributed to the contact, which ended Piastri's sprint and left Norris eighth.

headline: No penalty after Stroll and Perez's Singapore sprint collision
body: Stroll and Perez received no penalty after their first-lap collision at Turn 16, which ended both drivers' sprints. Stroll was not at fault for the contact.

headline: No penalty for Albon or Bottas after Singapore sprint contact
body: Albon and Bottas received no penalty after the Turn 16 chain collision involving Bortoleto before the Safety Car restart. Albon hit Bortoleto and Bottas hit Albon as the queue of cars slowed at different rates.

headline: Antonelli finds more from Mercedes' upgrades in qualifying
body: Antonelli qualified fourth after setup changes helped him find a better balance with Mercedes' Singapore upgrades. The car's operating window remains small, but he felt more comfortable than he had earlier in the weekend.

headline: Leclerc and Hamilton rue mistakes in Singapore pole fight
body: Leclerc missed pole by 0.054s after struggling with the car pulling under braking in Q1 and Q2, then making mistakes on his final Q3 lap. Hamilton topped Q1 and Q2 but lost the car's balance in Q3, with snaps of oversteer leaving him third.

headline: Hadjar fails to set a qualifying time after more power trouble
body: Hadjar's engine switched off in Q1 and he failed to set a representative qualifying lap. He also reported a gearbox failure and called for a fresh power unit for Sunday's race, but a change had not been confirmed.

headline: Stella to speak privately with Norris and Piastri after sprint clash
body: Andrea Stella called the McLaren drivers' Singapore sprint collision unacceptable and said he would discuss it with them privately. The team scored just one point, with Norris eighth and Piastri retiring.

headline: Provisional starting grid for the Singapore Grand Prix
body: Verstappen and Leclerc share the front row, ahead of Hamilton and Antonelli. Russell's power-unit penalty puts him on the back row with Hadjar. This is the provisional grid; post-qualifying decisions and car changes may still alter it before Sunday's race.
